description: Parameter 'message' in /contact_submit reflects untrusted input directly into the HTML document without adequate contextual encoding.
impact: An attacker can execute arbitrary JavaScript in the context of the victim's session, enabling session hijacking, credential theft, or unauthorized actions.
remediation:
1. Contextually encode all user-supplied data in parameter 'message' before rendering it in the HTML body, attributes, or script blocks.
2. Implement a strict Content Security Policy (CSP) with nonce-based script execution.
3. Set `HttpOnly` and `SameSite=Strict/Lax` flags on all sensitive session cookies.

evidence.analysis: Verdict: CONFIRMED. Signals: Raw unescaped script probe reflected in response. Reproducible targeted probe confirmed XSS with distinct reflection/error pattern (CVSS: 6.1, Vector: CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:R/S:C/C:L/I:L/A:N)
